items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You know, had Les been born later he would've been just as wonderful, he was a great saxophone player, yet Benny and Les Robinson were like oil and water.

ctx.x: You know, had Les been born later he would've been just as wonderful, he was a great saxophone player, yet Benny and Les Robinson were like oil and water. So were Benny and Artie.
